content: {"episode_id": "ep-05295", "cpt": "93247", "denial_carc": "PR-204", "necessity_paragraph": "The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope that are unexplained by standard evaluation, occurring in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (diagnosis codes R55, I34.0).
